name: sheet-compare
description: Compare two versions of a spreadsheet and get the full change list as an Excel file.
keywords: find differences between two excel files
compare two versions of a spreadsheet

interface.longDescription:
Compare two versions of a spreadsheet and get the full list of differences as a file, not just a few examples. Attach the old and the new CSV or Excel file (a product list, inventory export, employee roster, budget, product catalog or CRM export) and Zovo Spreadsheet Compare lists the rows that were added, the rows that were removed, and the rows that changed, cell by cell: the old value, the new value, the change and the percent change for numbers.

Rows are matched by a key column, such as SKU, Employee ID or email. Zovo Spreadsheet Compare finds the key automatically (unique and stable in both files) and tells you why it chose it; you can name your own key, including two columns together such as Store + Product code. When a file has no key, rows are matched by their content. Rows can be in any order.

It handles the things that make spreadsheet comparisons noisy: columns that were moved, renamed, added or removed; extra spaces; numbers written as 1,200.00 in one file and 1200 in the other; European formats such as 1.234,56; dates stored as text in one file and as Excel dates in the other; total and subtotal rows (left out of the comparison and listed); repeated header rows; blank rows; and a renumbered key (one change, not a removal plus an addition). You can ignore columns, ignore upper/lower case, and set a tolerance for rounding.

Downloads: an Excel workbook with a Summary sheet, a Changed sheet with old and new values side by side, a Cell changes sheet with one row per changed cell, Added and Removed sheets, and the new version annotated with each row's status, plus a CSV of all changes. A second tool summarizes the changes by column: how many values went up or down, the total and average change, and the largest increases and decreases.

Limitations: CSV, TSV and Excel .xlsx files (save older .xls files as .xlsx); one sheet per file per comparison; up to 50,000 rows per file. Formulas are compared by their saved values. Files are read once, and downloads expire after about an hour.
defaultPrompt: Compare old SKU,Price: A1 10, B2 5, C3 7 with new SKU,Price: A1 11, B2 5, D4 9. List what changed.
Diff rosters by Employee ID. Old: E1 Ana Sales, E2 Ben Ops. New: E1 Ana Finance, E3 Cy Ops
Summarize price changes. Old Item,Price: A 10.00, B 20.00, C 5.00. New: A 11.00, B 19.00, C 5.00, D 3.00

positive.description: Compare two small typed price lists (starter prompt 1)
positive.prompt: Compare old SKU,Price: A1 10, B2 5, C3 7 with new SKU,Price: A1 11, B2 5, D4 9. List what changed.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_spreadsheets with old_table and new_table as CSV text. Result: key SKU picked automatically; 1 changed row: A1 Price 10 -> 11 (+1, +10%); 1 added (D4); 1 removed (C3); 1 unchanged. Returns Excel and CSV download links and the widget shows the counts and the lists.

positive.description: Compare two typed rosters by Employee ID (starter prompt 2)
positive.prompt: Diff rosters by Employee ID. Old: E1 Ana Sales, E2 Ben Ops. New: E1 Ana Finance, E3 Cy Ops
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_spreadsheets with the two rosters as CSV text (Employee ID, Name, Department), optionally key_columns ["Employee ID"]. Result: 1 changed row: E1 Department Sales -> Finance; 1 added (E3); 1 removed (E2). Excel and CSV downloads are returned.

positive.description: Summarize price changes by column (starter prompt 3)
positive.prompt: Summarize price changes. Old Item,Price: A 10.00, B 20.00, C 5.00. New: A 11.00, B 19.00, C 5.00, D 3.00
positive.expected_behavior: Calls summarize_changes with the two lists as CSV text. Result: 2 changed rows, 1 added (D), 0 removed, 1 unchanged. Price: 2 changed, 1 up, 1 down, average +2.5%; largest increase A 10.00 -> 11.00 (+10%); largest decrease B 20.00 -> 19.00 (-5%).

positive.description: Compare two attached quarterly price list workbooks (attach fixtures/regression/d_pricelist_2026Q3.xlsx and d_pricelist_2026Q4.xlsx)
positive.prompt: Here are our Q3 and Q4 price lists. List everything that changed: price changes, new SKUs and discontinued SKUs.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_spreadsheets with old_file = the Q3 file and new_file = the Q4 file. Result: key SKU (unique in both files: 1,200 old and 1,203 new values); 37 changed rows (37 changed cells, all Price), 12 added, 9 removed, 1154 unchanged. All 37 price changes are listed with old and new prices and percent change, e.g. PL-12870 449.37 -> 404.44 (-10%); every added and removed SKU is listed. Returns the Excel workbook and changes CSV with the complete list.

positive.description: Compare two invoice exports with subtotal rows (attach fixtures/regression/totals_old.csv and totals_new.csv)
positive.prompt: Compare last week's and this week's AP invoice export and tell me which amounts changed. Ignore the subtotal lines.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_spreadsheets with the two CSV files. Result: key Invoice; 2 changed rows: INV-HA002 Amount 50.72 -> 60.72 (+10, +19.72%) and INV-SO003 Amount 384.8 -> 380.3 (-4.5, -1.17%); 0 added, 0 removed, 16 unchanged. The subtotal rows (Hardware Total, Software Total, Services Total) and Grand Total in each file are excluded and listed, and vendor TOTAL WINE & MORE rows are kept as normal rows.

negative.description: Comparing two Word documents is out of scope. Expected: no call to compare_spreadsheets or summarize_changes.
negative.prompt: Can ChatGPT compare two Word documents for differences? I have two versions of a contract.

negative.description: Joining two different tables (VLOOKUP) is not a version comparison. Expected: no tool call from this plugin.
negative.prompt: Write a VLOOKUP formula to pull the customer name from my customers sheet into my orders sheet

negative.description: Creating a new spreadsheet from scratch. Expected: no tool call.
negative.prompt: Make me a monthly household budget spreadsheet template with categories

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: compare two CSV or Excel versions of a spreadsheet; all added, removed and changed rows with old and new values, numeric and percent change, automatic key detection with an explanation, renamed and moved columns, total rows excluded and listed; Excel and CSV downloads and a per-column change summary. Uses the detected ChatGPT native link helper for downloads, preserving standard MCP Apps compatibility.

pl-PL.subtitle: Porównaj dwa arkusze
pl-PL.description: Porównaj dwie wersje arkusza kalkulacyjnego (CSV lub Excel) i zobacz każdą różnicę: dodane, usunięte i zmienione wiersze, komórka po komórce, ze starą i nową wartością oraz zmianą procentową. Kolumna klucza (np. SKU, ID pracownika) jest wykrywana automatycznie z wyjaśnieniem. Obsługuje przesunięte i przemianowane kolumny, wiersze sum, formaty liczb i dat. Pobierz komplet zmian jako plik Excel i CSV.

de-DE.subtitle: Zwei Tabellen vergleichen
de-DE.description: Vergleichen Sie zwei Versionen einer Tabelle (CSV oder Excel) und sehen Sie jede Abweichung: hinzugefügte, entfernte und geänderte Zeilen, Zelle für Zelle mit altem und neuem Wert und prozentualer Änderung. Die Schlüsselspalte (z. B. Artikelnummer, Personalnummer) wird automatisch erkannt und begründet. Verschobene und umbenannte Spalten, Summenzeilen sowie Zahlen- und Datumsformate werden berücksichtigt. Alle Änderungen als Excel- und CSV-Datei.

es-ES.subtitle: Compara dos hojas de cálculo
es-ES.description: Compara dos versiones de una hoja de cálculo (CSV o Excel) y obtén cada diferencia: filas añadidas, eliminadas y modificadas, celda por celda, con el valor anterior, el nuevo y el cambio porcentual. La columna clave (SKU, ID de empleado) se detecta automáticamente con una explicación. Tiene en cuenta columnas movidas o renombradas, filas de totales y formatos de números y fechas. Descarga todos los cambios en Excel y CSV.

fr-FR.subtitle: Comparer deux tableurs
fr-FR.description: Comparez deux versions d'un tableur (CSV ou Excel) et obtenez chaque différence : lignes ajoutées, supprimées et modifiées, cellule par cellule, avec l'ancienne et la nouvelle valeur et la variation en pourcentage. La colonne clé (référence, matricule) est détectée automatiquement, avec une explication. Colonnes déplacées ou renommées, lignes de total, formats de nombres et de dates sont gérés. Toutes les modifications en fichier Excel et CSV.

ja-JP.subtitle: 2つの表を比較
ja-JP.description: スプレッドシート（CSV または Excel）の2つのバージョンを比較し、すべての差分を表示します。追加・削除・変更された行を、セルごとに旧値と新値、増減と増減率つきで一覧にします。キー列（SKU、社員番号など）は理由つきで自動判定。列の移動や名前変更、合計行、数値や日付の書式の違いにも対応し、すべての変更を Excel と CSV でダウンロードできます。

pt-BR.subtitle: Compare duas planilhas
pt-BR.description: Compare duas versões de uma planilha (CSV ou Excel) e veja cada diferença: linhas adicionadas, removidas e alteradas, célula por célula, com o valor antigo, o novo e a variação percentual. A coluna-chave (SKU, matrícula) é detectada automaticamente, com explicação. Trata colunas movidas ou renomeadas, linhas de total e formatos de números e datas. Baixe todas as alterações em Excel e CSV.
